messages:
Ivy: FYI BrightCart just hit 4xx/latency during a mid-day burst. Customer says dedicated pool didn't scale quickly, traffic queued -> 429s. Ticket #INC-8221, attaching their sample request ids.
Carlos: Can you drop the root logs / earliest probe timestamps? Is this the warmchain case or imagepull backlog?
Ivy: Pasted earliest logs they collected: `req=bc-9a2 start=2026-03-18T15:02:10Z error=429`. No imagepull errors in their raw logs, but they see long queueing in our attach logs.
Ivy: OPSBOT alert: "autoscaler: probe_rate_limit_exceeded tenant=brightcart pool=dedicated-eu-west" (this is in our console at 15:02:12).
OpsBot: alert:autoscaler_probe_rate_limit_exceeded brightcart dedicated-eu-west 2026-03-18T15:02:12Z :warning:
Mira: That probe_rate_limit_exceeded is interesting — might be the probe gating we added to protect registry. Could be racing with minReplicas rollup. What are their min/max?
Ivy: BrightCart config: minReplicas=2, maxReplicas=50, targetCPU=60%. They reported spike ~x25 baseline, spikes were short (couple secs).
Carlos: Two hypotheses: 1) probe backoff + controller pacing prevented new warmpool attach requests from even being sent (probe throttle), 2) scheduler/imagepull/kube attach stuck behind a quota (less likely given no imagepull errors). Need controller logs around 15:01:50-15:03:00.
Ivy: Repro steps customer provided: a scripted burst hitting endpoint with concurrency 200 for 20s.
Carlos: Can you run this locally in staging to reproduce with warmpool size=2? Quick repro in our staging:
```
# run load test
wrk -t8 -c200 -d20s https://staging-api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Ivy: Doing it now on the staging tenant clone.
Mira: Also check autoscaler controller logs: `kubectl -n redwood logs deploy/autoscaler-controller --since=10m` — look for `probe_rate_limit` and `handshake_queue_len`. If probes were suppressed, controller will hold off new attach requests until quota window resets.
Carlos: Found the controller trace in staging: `probe_rate_limit: 503ms backoff, queued=34, handshakes_inflight=2`. That matches the symptom: attach requests delayed, warm chains not created fast enough.
Ivy: Customer says when they manually bumped minReplicas to 10 during incident, latency dropped immediately.
Mira: Good signal — indicates autoscaler couldn't keep up with burst unless min floor raised. For mitigation: 1) temporarily raise minReplicas for high-QPS tenants, 2) increase probe concurrency window for Dedicated for tiered customers, 3) add lightweight short-lived probe path to speed attach (engineering change).
Carlos: Short-term fix for BrightCart: escalate to Dedicated ops to run `kubectl scale --replicas=12 deployment/brightcart-dedicated --namespace=tenants-brightcart` and request reserved burst capacity if available. I'll own an infra PR to expose probe window as a per-tenant knob.
Ivy: I've told customer we'll scale them manually and follow up with permanent fix. They want repro steps and logs; sending them controller traces + our staging reproduce notes.
Eli: Filing follow-up ticket RFC-1147 to track probe-window config and per-tenant minReplicas recommendations for bursty customers. Adding owners: Carlos (eng-runtime), Mira (eng-sre), Ivy (support).
Mira: Postmortem notes: add metrics for `attach_request_latency` and `probe_queue_depth` to console and alert thresholds when probe_queue_depth > 10 for >30s. Also add runbook: "if probe_queue_depth high during customer spike -> temporary minReplicas bump or request dedicated reserved burst."
Carlos: For now I'll push a small change to staging to increase probe concurrency from 50->150 for dedicated-eu-west and rerun the wrk test. Will report back in ~15m.
Ivy: Customer updated: we scaled them up and latency dropped. They asked for root cause and timeline. Sending a short timeline and mitigation steps. :thumbsup:
OpsBot: incident-update INC-8221 assigned -> team=eng-runtime severity=high
Carlos: Verified staging reproduce with increased probe concurrency — attach lag reduced from ~8s to ~1.2s under same load. Will propose threshold gating and per-tenant override in PR.
Mira: Adding to runbook and marking this thread for follow-up postmortem.
Ivy: Thanks team, I'll close the customer loop and share the mitigation steps + recommended config.
Carlos: Action items: (1) PR to expose probe window per-tenant (owner: Carlos), (2) Dashboard for probe_queue_depth (owner: Mira), (3) Support runbook update (owner: Ivy).
Ivy: closing notes posted to INC-8221 and customer message drafted.
Eli: Adding post-incident review to next ops retro.
